# Sudipta Dey - Portfolio

> Staff Engineer working on applied AI and backend systems.

## About

Sudipta leads engineering for production AI systems at Methodic Labs and is a founding engineer at Checko, where he built a product authentication platform handling 100M+ annual label uploads. At Creed, he built backend systems for AI chat, voice, memory, and personalized notifications.

B.Tech in Computer Science, Sikkim Manipal Institute of Technology, 2020 (8.13/10). Former president of the Photography and Art Clubs.

- Location: Hyderabad, India
- Email: dey.sudipta@outlook.in
- Available for: Consulting, Technical Advisory, Full-time roles

- Two AI systems in daily client use in about seven weeks
- 100M+ annual label uploads

## Experience

### Methodic Labs (Deployly) - Staff Engineer (Sep 2026 - Present)
- Led architecture and delivery for two AI systems that reached daily client use in about seven weeks.
- Built a Twilio/LiveKit appointment-confirmation agent with Raintree write-back, a live-call deploy gate, and 450+ backend tests.
- Built a Next.js, PostgreSQL, and Claude questionnaire platform with Decipher XML export, deterministic logic checks, and an $8 model budget per study.
- Built Anderson’s Salesforce Lightning intake with sandbox-verified prefill and backtested AI validation on 300 historical cases.

### Checko (Transpacks Technologies Pvt Ltd) - Founding Engineer (Apr 2021 - Present)
- Built a product authentication platform handling 100M+ annual label uploads. Cut processing time for 10 million images from 1–4 days to 30 minutes.
- Scaled apps to 100K+ downloads and 20K+ monthly active users across four countries.
- Cut compute costs by 30% and halved technology spend. Helped raise gross margin by 5 percentage points.
- Hired and mentored eight engineers. Increased deployment velocity 5× with trunk-based CI/CD.

### Creed - Staff Engineer (Nov 2025 - Aug 2026)
- Architected a multi-provider LLM layer for chat, voice, and memory. Production logs show ~190K daily completions and ~6K recovered via failover.
- Rebuilt a Celery and Vertex Gemini pipeline handling ~700K daily pushes and cut ~130K daily model requests without reducing sends.
- Improved mem0 and pgvector retrieval to surface 24% more memories in a 30-user sample. Cut worst-case conversation compaction from 44s to 0.5s across 113 million messages.

### NCFlexE, IIT Kanpur - Project Associate and Summer Intern (Jun 2020 - Mar 2021)
- Delivered 4+ R&D projects across ML, automation, and backend
- Built Android apps with OpenCV, TensorFlow, and ML Kit
- Managed GCP/AWS services for datasets with 100K+ records

### Boston Scientific - Software Development Engineer Intern (Jan 2020 - Jun 2020)
- Developed internal web apps using PrimeFaces and ThingWorx
- Integrated Windchill data via Swagger REST APIs

### The Sparks Foundation - Project Intern (May 2019 - Aug 2019)

### Manipal Institute of Technology - Summer Intern (May 2019 - Aug 2019)

### Startup Consulting - Technical Consultant (Ongoing)
- Advising startups on architecture, scalability, and MVP launches.
